name: Editorial notebook
description: Calm cream paper, italic serif accent word, windows and terminals that swing in. Explains one idea simply.
rules: One accent colour (orange) used for the single most important word or number per shot.
Headline words rise out of a mask; the accent word is italic serif.
Windows and phones swing in from the right with a small 3D turn; everything exits before the next shot starts.
Real screenshots beat drawn UI: use ProofCard or BrowserWindow with a capture whenever a real thing is named.
Motion is calm: springs with little overshoot, no shake, no flashes.
camera_language: No camera: layout and motion only. Slow 2 percent push on cards.
typography: Heavy sans headlines, italic serif accent, mono labels.
audio_direction: upbeat bed, soft pop on each card, tick on steps, type on terminals, ding on the comment box
pitfalls: More than one accent word per shot.
A fake screenshot of a real site.
Shots longer than 4 s without a new element appearing.
